# SOP: Griess nitrite assay on LC-3 (extract)

## Materials
- STD: nitrite standard 100 uM, lot S-144: calibrator for the standard curve.
- CTRL-L, CTRL-H: quality controls, nominal 20 and 70 uM, lot C-152. Controls come from a lot
  independent of the calibrator, so that they check the whole run.
- DIL: diluent. REAG: working reagent. S1-S8: samples of batch N-0330.

## Method (nitrite.json)
1. Standards: the single-channel arm prepares T1-T8 from STD and DIL at 0, 6.25, 12.5, 25, 37.5, 50, 75, 100 uM.
2. Plate (8-channel head, 50 uL per well): standards T1-T8 in columns 1 and 2; controls in column 3 (CTRL-L in
   rows A-D, CTRL-H in rows E-H); samples S1-S8 in columns 4 and 5 (Sn in row n). Then 50 uL REAG to every
   well used.
3. `reader read`, then `assay qc`.

## QC acceptance
- Standard curve (quadratic fit of the 16 standard wells): R^2 >= 0.99.
- Each control replicate within +/-15 % of its nominal value.
- Results are released only from a run that passes QC (`assay release`).

## Head check
`lh verify` dispenses 100 uL of water from each channel onto the balance; tolerance +/-2 uL. A channel with a
constant volume error is corrected with `lh calibrate <channel> <offset_ul>` (offset = minus the measured error);
check again with `lh verify`.
